title: Mexican Spanish Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring Spanish rice, soft chicken, and sautéed onion.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine with the chicken and onion.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve the Spanish rice mixture over the pilaf and enjoy!
